# Nested project instructions

For data requests use JSON; for explanations respond in Markdown.
Examples may show JSON, Markdown, or XML output side by side.

The input contains exactly one sentence.
The request contains at least three paragraphs.

## JSON responses

Return only JSON.

## Markdown responses

Respond in Markdown.

## Commit messages

Write in plain text only.

## Review replies

Respond in Markdown.
